variantes.supervivencia: His Terrifying Vision can physically age the target by decades in a single turn. Even worse: his Possession can turn a partymate into a weapon against you. Attack with radiant damage and keep your will high. If it possesses someone, it forces radiant area damage.
variantes.habilidad: Can possess a humanoid (WIS DC 13) by taking full control of its body. Revealing its true form, it ages the target by 1d4 x 10 years on a failed CON save, an effect that can only be reversed with magic. Can enter the Ethereal Plane as an action.
variantes.lore: The ghost does not know that he is dead. That is the tragedy and the danger. He continues to live the moment of his death, repeating actions, defending spaces that no longer belong to him, claiming loyalties from people who have been in the grave for decades. Interfering with their routine is a provocation that can cost a reckless adventurer decades of life.

variantes.resistente: Resistant to almost all physical or elemental damage / Immune to Necrotic and Poison.
variantes.supervivencia: Don't try to block their path, as they slide through solid matter and walls without problems. Their fearsome attacks deplete your Maximum Hit Points directly, so a couple of hits could mean permanent death with no chance of magical healing. Force them to fight in sunlight to drastically reduce their capabilities, or try to damage them with force magic, as they will resist the vast majority of conventional weapons. Another sacred rule: keep the fallen away; They can tear the soul out of fresh corpses to turn them against you.
variantes.habilidad: They take advantage of their ethereal nature to traverse terrain and ignore barriers. Its deadly touch consumes life force, reducing maximum Hit Points until the target is completely killed. In addition, they have the terrifying necromantic ability to raise a recently dead humanoid, transforming it into a specter at their command (up to 7 simultaneously).
variantes.lore: The apparitions are deadly corrupt spirits thirsting for living life that embody pure evil. They emerge as a result of unfathomable suffering, catastrophic atrocities committed by tyrants in life, or aberrant dark magic. These evil remnants dwell in the eternal gloom of forgotten lands, blindly longing to spread pain by snatching the soul of anyone who dares to disturb their rest.

variantes.resistente: Acid, forceful, cutting, fire, piercing, lightning, thunder. Immunity to cold, necrotic, poison.
variantes.supervivencia: Avoid facing her in the dark if possible and be sure to strengthen your will. A success in resisting its terror immunizes you for a day, but if it utters its deadly wail, those who falter can lose all their vitality in an instant.
variantes.habilidad: The banshee drains vitality through a corrupting touch and has terrifying power over minds. He can emit a Death Wail (once a day, away from sunlight) that shatters spirits and can instantly strike down creatures that hear it.
variantes.lore: Banshees, messengers of misfortune and scourge of the living, are spirits obsessed by unresolved bitterness or sadness. These legendary ghostly beings take the lives of anyone who glimpses them or hears their sinister howls. Although any tormented soul can revive as a banshee, they are especially feared by some elven communities, who believe that those who accumulate or destroy beauty (natural or otherwise) risk returning as these beings.

variantes.habitat: High Security Prisons, Desolate Places, Intense Fog
variantes.supervivencia: Never approach without a spell that projects pure positive energy (such as a Patronus). Their very presence drains hope and can paralyze you with terror. If they catch you, they will attempt the 'Dementor's Kiss', which does not kill the body but consumes the soul, leaving an empty shell. Keep your distance and use powerful radiant light.
variantes.habilidad_titulo: Aura of Despair and Dementor's Kiss
variantes.habilidad: Any creature that begins its turn within 30 feet must succeed on a Wisdom save or be frightened and have its speed reduced to 0. Dementor's Kiss is an action against an incapacitated creature: it drains its soul, reducing its maximum HP to 0 instantly; requires high level magic to reverse.
variantes.lore: Dementors are some of the most nauseating creatures that inhabit the earth. They infest the darkest and dirtiest places, they rejoice in decay and despair, they drain the air around them of peace, hope and joy. They have no eyes, only a mouth that sucks the souls of their victims. They are loyal to no one, only to whoever gives them the most souls to consume.

drana.supervivencia: Be careful of his multiple attacks and deceptive magic. They have excellent vision in the dark and walk freely over cobwebs without being hindered. Try to bring them into sunlight or use flashes, as they suffer disadvantage in these conditions; and prepares antidotes for its poisonous outburst.
drana.habilidad_titulo: Agile Attacks and Magic of the Spider Queen
drana.habilidad: The drier takes advantage of its fearsome legs and ability to climb ceilings to ambush. It can make up to three quick attacks, alternating between attacks with its sharp front paws or a ranged blast of poison. Thanks to Lolth's blessing, they sometimes conjure darkness, cobwebs, or faerie fire.
drana.lore: Driders combine traits of drow and giant spiders. The evil goddess Lolth is prone to transforming her drow worshipers into dredges, either as a blessing or a curse. These driders often become fanatical servants of their goddess, or are overwhelmed by their transformation and live solely to satisfy their predatory spider instincts. Dredders also appear when entire communities are transformed by the wrath of an evil god or other magical means, although they could also be part of a world's natural population. Most live underground or in lush forests, where they can best take advantage of their agile arachnid features.

gargola.resistente: Immunity to: poison (damage), exhaustion, poisoned and petrified status.
gargola.supervivencia: Carefully examine the statues and architecture before moving forward. Their months-long patience makes them deadly surprise attackers. They have the ability to retreat in the air without suffering attacks of opportunity, so prioritize intercepting them in flight or attacking from a distance and trapping them.
gargola.habilidad: They take advantage of their stone appearance to blend in completely in urban or cavernous environments, ambushing without prior warning. In combat they use their "Fly by" ability to approach, attack and retreat with their wings without receiving attacks of opportunity, thus wearing down prey with their claws.
gargola.lore: Gargoyles are sculptures inhabited by elemental spirits. These lumbering stone creatures fly using magic and their wings, and often land in places where they go unnoticed, such as ornate architecture, rock formations, or ordinary statues. They normally serve the magic users who breathed life into them; However, if they roam freely, they may play cruel pranks and steal treasures, which they then store in elevated lairs.  Having no biological needs and possessing supernatural patience, they can wait motionless for months for their ideal ambush.

variantes.habitat: Water, coast, swamps, Plane of Water
variantes.resistente: Resistance: Acid, fire. Immunity: Poison, grabbed, captured, tired, knocked down, poisoned, unconscious, paralyzed, petrified.
variantes.supervivencia: Extreme caution when diving; They can engulf you and crush you in their watery form (Anegar). If you manage to deal cold damage to them, you will considerably reduce their speed, gaining advantage to attack them and retreat.
variantes.habilidad: They take advantage of their instability to shape themselves, being able to suffocate and internally beat the creatures they trap inside. They can move freely, occupying enemy space without any restrictions.
variantes.lore: The spirits of the Elemental Plane of Water transform amorphous liquids into water elementals, which are watery beings that possess the power of waves. They are as mutable as any liquid, allowing them to break like waves against their enemies and seep through narrow crevices. They are capable of crushing their adversaries with geyser-like limbs or falling like a flood on other creatures to drown them in their agitated interior.

variantes.habitat: Mountains, deserts, skies, Plane of Air
variantes.resistente: Resistance: Blunt, cutting, piercing, lightning. Immunities: Thunder, poison, tired, knocked down, poisoned, unconscious, paralyzed, petrified.
variantes.supervivencia: Keep your distance if possible to avoid being hit or thrown by its raging whirlwind. Their very high resistance to traditional weapons requires using arcane arts to damage them.
variantes.habilidad: They move freely through enemy space. They use violent gusts of wind to create a "Whirlwind" capable of pushing multiple enemies with thunderous force, throwing or knocking down anyone in its path.
variantes.lore: Air elementals are energy spirits of the Elemental Plane of Air that gather together clouds and winds to form ever-changing bodies with diffuse limbs and vague features. Outside their plane of origin, they can serve magic users who conjure them or congregate in planarly unstable nexuses.

variantes.resistente: Resistance: Blunt, cutting, piercing. Immunity: Fire, poison, grabbed, captured, tired, knocked down, poisoned, unconscious, paralyzed, petrified.
variantes.supervivencia: Abundant water is its greatest enemy: throwing water or attracting it to water sources damages it for every meter it enters. Do not bring flammable components close to this Elemental; It will incinerate you alive just by staying close.
variantes.habilidad: They have a Fire Aura that emanates constant scorching heat, and set fire to everything flammable in their path. They have complete immunity to fire and deal immense area thermal damage just by passing by you.
variantes.lore: Fire elementals arise when the spirits of flames inhabit candles or fires. They usually burn with red, orange, or varied flames, and are tangible, and can quickly ignite their enemies due to their insatiable destructive appetite.

variantes.habitat: Mountains, caverns, Plane of the Earth
variantes.resistente: Immunity: Poison, tired, poisoned, unconscious, paralyzed, petrified.
variantes.supervivencia: An earth elemental is physically and structurally devastating; can appear from beneath the ground (excluding manufactured soil, as long as it is not magical), throwing large blocks of rock at you. Take advantage of their sonic weakness or thunder element spells and avoid taking refuge in conventional walls.
variantes.habilidad: It glides through pure rock without disturbing it. In addition, it is a natural Siege Monster capable of completely bending and ruining any structure or object with blows from an immense stone mass.
variantes.lore: The primordial spirits of the Plane of Earth fuse with rocks and minerals, forming heavy colossi whose limbs resemble rough rocks. Immensely strong and unstoppable; In their fists they bring destruction.

marchitas.supervivencia: Extremely weak against fire. Don't let your guard down when camping in the woods; They camouflage themselves perfectly between bundles of firewood and dry vegetation, and they will set up ambushes, attacking in groups to saturate your defenses.
marchitas.habilidad: They take advantage of numerical superiority to surround their prey. The 'Needle' variants can expel bursts of splintering projectiles at high speed while the 'Branch' variants attack in melee.
marchitas.lore: The withers are evil plant spawns that sprout where the deepest evil has corrupted the earth. They have gnarled shapes that vaguely emulate emaciated human limbs, and their twisted faces reflect pure hatred. Where they appear, natural vegetation dies, water wells stagnate and animals flee in terror.

hidra.supervivencia: Firearms or fiery spells are vital; fire damage prevents the hydra from growing new heads. Focus on causing severe damage to sever their heads, trying to burn off the wounds before the end of their turn.
hidra.habilidad: The hydra has five heads. For each head you have besides the first, you get an additional reaction for attacks of opportunity. If you take 25 or more points of damage in a single turn, you lose one of your heads. If they all die, the hydra will die. At the end of your turn, you grow two new heads for every head lost since your last turn, unless you have taken fire damage. Recovers 20 HP with each new head.
hidra.lore: Hydras are legendary hero-slayers with rabid serpentine heads and famous regenerative powers. Prey to infinite hunger, they devour all the creatures they catch. Hydras that destroy all prey usually enter a prolonged torpor until new ones arrive. Although many have their own territories, sometimes they guard places or treasures of evil deities.

magmin.supervivencia: Keep your distance whenever possible, as these little elementals explode violently upon death. Use ranged attacks and try to avoid them getting close to flammable objects. His touch will set fire to anything unprotected, making close combat extremely risky.
magmin.habilidad: When the magmin dies, it explodes. All creatures within 10 feet must make a Dexterity saving throw (DC 11), taking 2d6 fire damage on a fail, or half as much on a success.
magmin.lore: Magmins see the world divided into two categories: what is already burning and what should burn. They are halfling-sized elemental creatures that act not out of malice, but out of the pure ecstasy that the primal fire produces. They are often drawn to places of extreme heat such as volcanoes, or are summoned by magicians seeking to use their destructive and flammable nature in combat.

ifrit.supervivencia: An Ifrit is a formidable foe, thanks to its massive hit point pool, innate magic resistance, and devastating fiery attacks. It is essential to have resistance to fire damage before engaging in combat. Since their dexterity is somewhat average, a good tactic is to use spells that require dexterity saving throws. Note that if they die outside the Plane of Fire, they are not permanently eradicated, but are reborn within a short time.
ifrit.habilidad: It has advantage on saving throws against spells. They deliver combo attacks with deadly red-hot blades and ranged blasts of fire. Additionally, they are capable of casting deadly spells such as 'Wall of Fire', and the most powerful ones can even grant a staggering amount of up to 3 'Wish' spells on extreme occasions.
ifrit.lore: Ifrits burn with the energy and unpredictability of fire. Their innate magic allows them to conjure flames from thin air and shape treasures into magical infernos. They dwell in stifling deserts and volcanic regions, although their true home is the Elemental Plane of Fire, where they have erected formidable resplendent metropolises such as the majestic Tinsel City.

amasijo_aniquilacion.resistente: Blunt, cutting, piercing / Immunity to acid, poison, paralyzed, petrified, etc.
amasijo_aniquilacion.supervivencia: This titanic ooze has a hazard of 6, indicating an apocalyptic challenge. Never allow it to move through your space, as its immense mass will absorb you and apply severe conditions while consuming you alive with continuous force damage and necrosis. Completely avoid unprotected melee attacks. Use attacks that do not require saving throws since it has powerful Legendary Resistances (4/day). If an ally becomes trapped by its slimy 'Restrictor Goo', focus your efforts on freeing it before it is pulled straight into its core.
amasijo_aniquilacion.habilidad: It moves, swallowing everything it touches. Anyone trapped in its pseudopod or mass is suffocated, blinded, and receives constant damage. If you manage to lower the hit points of an absorbed creature to 0, the victim is pulverized. When the Mash of Annihilation dies, it implodes, destroying itself, expelling all those swallowed into the Astral Sea and leaving a chaotic layer of viscous slime for 180 meters around. It will return sooner or later after 1d20 years.
amasijo_aniquilacion.lore: The Mash of Annihilation is not a purposeful deity, but a catastrophe incarnate, a slimy, entropic mass, a primordial titan the size of enormous buildings or entire towns, completely blind in its destruction. It acts like a cosmic predator, dissolving all structure and life forms as it passes through the material multiverse, leaving behind only sticky emptiness.

falsa_hidra.habitat: Towns and kingdoms plagued by massive lies and propaganda
falsa_hidra.supervivencia: Fighting a False Hydra is a purely psychological war. Its horrendous song will force you to ignore it and erase everyone it devours from your memory. To confront her, you must cover your ears or use magic that prevents you from hearing to break her mental illusion. Be extremely careful: the more people it consumes, the more heads it grows, granting it formidable additional hit points, deadly multiple attacks, and numerous reactions per turn.
falsa_hidra.habilidad: It sings a grotesque melody within a 5-mile radius that dominates the mind, causing its existence (and that of its devoured victims) to be erased and justified with lies created by your own brain temporarily. It grows by ingesting its prey; for each new head it gains Hit Points, advantages against most status debuffs, and a new bite attack capable of grappling its target up to 30 feet away.
falsa_hidra.lore: The origin of the False Hydra is one of the darkest horrors of arcane lore. It begins as a white, rotting lump beneath the soil of cities drowning in lies and propaganda. Bursting to the surface like a pale, deformed infant, he sings a perpetual song that charms the entire community into ignoring his gigantic presence. Unlike a regular monster, the False Hydra's danger escalates, going from stalking lost inhabitants to enslaving entire nations when it matures.

armadura_animada.supervivencia: Animated armor is extremely susceptible to countermagic. If you have a Dispel Magic spell or are in an anti-magic field, they will be completely useless or unconscious. Avoid psychic or poison attacks as they are immune to them.
armadura_animada.habilidad: The armor is incapacitated while it remains in the area of ​​an antimagic field. If it is the target of 'Dispel Magic', it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the spell's DC or fall unconscious for 1 minute. As long as it is completely still, it is indistinguishable from normal decorative armor.
armadura_animada.lore: This imposing, magically animated plate armor clamors and grinds with its every metallic movement, sounding tragically like the noisy vengeful spirit of an ancient fallen knight. They are terrifying, unbreakable guardians usually crafted by sorcerers to guard deadly treasures.

variantes.resistente: Non-magical physical; Immune to Fire and Poison
variantes.supervivencia: It is essential to use silver weapons or ammunition to avoid their resistance if you do not have lethal spells. They try to take advantage of the height to avoid being hit by melee warriors.
variantes.habilidad: At will, he can become completely invisible. It can transform into a rat, crow or spider. He has absolute Devil's Sight to pierce any magical darkness.
variantes.lore: The Imp is the epitome of diplomatic malice in the infernal hierarchy. These beings do not seek direct destruction, but rather the slow and meticulous corruption of the soul. They come to the mortal world under the guise of familiars, offering forbidden knowledge and protection to ambitious wizards, while weaving a web of debts and sins that ensure their 'master's' soul is claimed by the Underworld upon his death.

variantes.supervivencia: Since you have few hit points, the key is to reveal them. Use spells that affect an area or magic that dispels their invisibility to avoid their poisonous ambushes.
variantes.habilidad: He becomes invisible at will and can transform into a bat, centipede or toad. Their attacks inject a debilitating poison that frightens their victims.
variantes.lore: A Quasit is a manifestation of the betrayal and irrational hatred that defines the Abyss. Unlike their diabolical counterparts, these little demons do not follow contracts, but rather destructive impulses. They serve mortal masters out of sheer ego or fear, but their loyalty lasts only as long as they see an opportunity to cause mischief. They enjoy sowing paranoia and sabotaging the plans of their supposed allies from the safety of their invisibility.

variantes.supervivencia: They're slow and stupid, but they regenerate unless you take radiant damage or use holy water. Use ranged attacks to avoid being surrounded.
variantes.habilidad: The only way to permanently destroy a lemure in the Hells is with radiant damage or holy water. Otherwise, their remains come back together in a matter of hours.
variantes.lore: The Lemure is the living testimony of eternal humiliation. In the diabolical hierarchy, they represent the end of the road for souls who could not pay their debts or failed their masters. They are masses of melted flesh that barely retain a parody of a human face, forced to crawl in perpetual agony until an archduke decides to transform them into something more useful... or use them as simple bricks in the wall of an infernal fortress.

variantes.supervivencia: Be careful with his Stinking Cloud. If they surround you, the smell can incapacitate you. Try to eliminate them before they exhale their gases.
variantes.habilidad: Once a day, the dretch may exhale a cloud of foul gas. Any creature inside must succeed on a Constitution save or be incapacitated by disgust.
variantes.lore: A Dretch is a creature of pure resentment. They arise from souls so insignificant in their malice that they cannot even transform into a true demon. Consumed by a self-hatred that they project onto everything around them, they wander the layers of the Abyss in whining hordes, drooling and snarling a cacophony of insults in a language they can no longer speak, but still feel in their fractured minds.

variantes.supervivencia: They are extremely weak. Any area spell will take them out by the dozens. They pose no real threat unless they outnumber the group 20 to 1.
variantes.habilidad: Upon death, a manes dissolves into a cloud of fetid vapor that has no mechanical effect, but its essence returns to the Abyss to reform almost instantly.
variantes.lore: The Manes are the lowest form of demonic life, a mass of festering vapor and rotting flesh that barely remembers its mortal past. They are little more than instinct and hunger, moved by a blind rage that leads them to attack any enemy, regardless of whether they are annihilated by the thousands. They are the ultimate tactical fodder, whose only importance lies in the overwhelming weight of their relentless numbers.

variantes.supervivencia: They are blind and guided by smell. If you maintain stealth or use magic to cover your tracks, they will ignore you. If they see you, they will chase you tirelessly.
variantes.habilidad: They can detect any creature other than a devil within a long radius by smell. They are immune to many conditions due to their lack of complex sensory organs.
variantes.lore: The Nupperibo is the result of a miscarriage of justice or a fall from grace within the Nine Hells. They are masses of swollen fat and ashy-colored skin, deprived of eyes, noses, or ears so that their only interaction with the multiverse is through smell and pain. They walk in grim, silent processions, responding only to the telepathic commands of their superiors, like biological automatons in a system that has discarded them.

variantes.resistente: Magic (Advantage), Immune to Poison and Corrosion
variantes.supervivencia: Dispelling its toxic cloud is vital. They are specialists in combat within sulfurous fumes. Use magic or silver weapons to ignore its tough crustacean skin.
variantes.habilidad: It launches immense annihilating clouds where it operates with total immunity. He can teleport instantly to chase those fleeing the poison.
variantes.lore: The Mezzoloth is the perfect infantryman for endless war. They are pragmatic and brutal beings who know no mercy, only the fulfillment of a contract. Covered in natural chitinous armor and capable of operating in the deadliest poison clouds, these mercenaries are the preferred choice of archmages and warlords who need a strike force that asks no questions and has no loyalty to anyone other than the promised gold or gems.

variantes.supervivencia: Be careful with their axes; They leave wounds that bleed and weaken. Being flyers, they will try to take the weakest members of the group to the heights.
variantes.habilidad: He can turn invisible and teleport at will. Their greave ax attacks cause bleeding that does not allow for rapid healing.
variantes.lore: A Nycaloth is an elite assassin whose very shadow is a harbinger of death. They act as the personal field marshals or executioners of the Yugoloth lords, using their ability to fly and invisibility to behead armies before battle begins. Their ethos is pure and simple business: they will kill a god if the price is right, and they will do so with a surgical efficiency that leaves their victims no time to even scream.

variantes.supervivencia: Never fight in hand-to-hand combat unless you have poison resistance; its stench will weaken you. It has magic resistance, so rely on pure physical attacks or ranged damage.
variantes.habilidad: It emanates an unbearable stench that poisons its attackers within 3 meters. It has advantage on saves against magic spells.
variantes.lore: The Hezrou is an aberration of festering flesh and reptilian ferocity, a mass of muscle and pustules that embodies the irrational brutality of the Abyss. There is no elegance to his attacks, only a clumsy violence that crushes and tears. Its smell is so powerful that it can wither plants in its path, and your mind is a whirlwind of insatiable hunger. They are used by demonic lords as line breakers, throwing them to the front so that their very presence demoralizes and poisons the will of mortal defenders.

variantes.supervivencia: Don't let them get close. Its humming affects everyone around it. Attacking from afar is imperative to prevent it from permanently draining your life points.
variantes.habilidad: Its buzzing forces Constitution saves or falling unconscious. Its proboscis permanently reduces the victim's maximum hit points.
variantes.lore: A Chasme is a winged inquisitor who patrols the iron skies of the abyssal layers in search of deserters or intruders. With their colossal insect appearance and hypnotic hum, these demons are masters of mental and physical torment. They enjoy extracting the life essence from their victims while they are still conscious, savoring the panic their presence provokes. The hum of a Chasme is said to be the last melody heard by souls trying to escape the tyranny of chaos.

variantes.resistente: Cold, non-magical weapons; Immune to Fire and Poison
variantes.supervivencia: Use cover against his poison arrows. Once knocked down on the ground, its versatility greatly declines.
variantes.habilidad: Fires arrows with lethal poison that ignores cover. Use a magical rope to trap and suffocate spellcasters.
variantes.lore: The Erinyes are the fallen angels of the Nine Hells, warriors of celestial beauty that hides a heart of pure cold iron. Unlike other devils, Erinyes rarely change their form, preferring to display themselves as champions of divine justice to deceive mortals before claiming their souls. They are Asmodeus' deadliest assassins, infallible hunters who use their entanglement ropes and poison bows to silence anyone who opposes the manifest destiny of lawful evil.

variantes.resistente: Cold, non-magical weapons; Fire and Poison (Immune)
variantes.supervivencia: They attack three times per turn with claws and a poisonous stinger. Make sure you have poison resistance and use silver attacks.
variantes.habilidad: Ignore the magical darkness. Its sting poisons upon striking, injecting toxins directly into the bloodstream.
variantes.lore: The Bone Devil, or Osyluth, is the perfect inquisitor of the infernal hierarchy. With a skeletal and mechanical appearance that hides a cold and calculating hatred, these beings are responsible for monitoring their inferiors and punishing any hint of rebellion. They feel no compassion or pleasure in combat; only an intellectual satisfaction in seeing the law of Asmodeus fulfilled. They are the guardians of the darkest truths of Hell and the executioners of those who dare to break a contract.

variantes.resistente: Cold, non-magical weapons; Immune to Fire and Poison
variantes.supervivencia: Stay away from the chains of the environment. Use radiant damage to weaken his control over animated metal.
variantes.habilidad: It can give life to nearby chains to attack and capture rivals. His gaze reveals the faces of deceased relatives to terrify.
variantes.lore: The Kyton is a creature of aesthetic torment, a jailer who has transformed pain into an art form. They dwell in the Iron City of Dis, where they animate chains to trap and flay those who have sinned against order. Their body is covered with scars and perforations that they inflict on themselves, seeking ecstasy in each blow received and delivered. For a Kyton, fear is a fragrance and flesh is the canvas upon which they sculpt their eternal devotion to the infernal hierarchy.

variantes.resistente: Magic (Advantage), Immune to Poison; Resistance to Fire, Cold, Lightning
variantes.supervivencia: Avoid both their glances. One kills, the other drives you crazy. You need mental restoration spells to prevent your companions from attacking each other in the middle of combat.
variantes.habilidad: Its two heads can wear different looks. One of them paralyzes the will and the other induces psychotic madness. He radiates a presence that distorts the reality around him.
variantes.lore: Demogorgon, the Prince of Demons, is the supreme embodiment of chaos and abyssal madness. Its two heads, Aameul and Hethradiah, represent an eternal duality of hatred and destruction that often conflict with each other, fragmenting their own will. He lives in the Abyss, in the realm of Gaping Maw, from where he radiates a presence that distorts reality and breaks the sanity of any mortal who dares to speak his name. He seeks not to conquer the multiverse, but to undo it piece by piece until only absolute emptiness and the silence of madness remain.

variantes.resistente: Magic, Immune to Poison, Cold, Fire, Lightning
variantes.supervivencia: Destroy his staff first if you have the chance. Orcus can summon legions of Liches and Death Knights in a single turn if not stopped quickly.
variantes.habilidad: A legendary artifact that allows him to conjure undead of immense power. Its simple touch can instantly kill any mortal creature not protected by divine grace.
variantes.lore: Orcus, Lord of the Undead, is a titan of evil who seeks to extinguish every spark of life in the multiverse to transform it into an eternal mausoleum under his command. From his bone throne in the frozen lands of Thanatos, he manipulates the threads of necromancy with terrifying mastery. His Rod of Orcus is an artifact of apocalyptic power that can raise legions of the dead with a single swing. For Orcus, life is a noisy, chaotic aberration that must be silenced so that the holy peace of the grave may reign, where he will be the sole eternal ruler.

variantes.supervivencia: Use charm protections. Graz'zt will win the fight simply by convincing your allies that you are the real enemy.
variantes.habilidad: Master of deception and evil diplomacy. She can cast charm spells as minor actions and her voice alone can force others to kneel before her dark majesty.
variantes.lore: Graz'zt, the Dark Prince, is the most scheming and seductive of the demon lords. Unlike his rivals, Graz'zt prefers deception, temptation, and forbidden joys to expand his influence over the planes. Rule a three-layered empire in the Abyss, Azzatar, where cities are monuments to decay and excess. He possesses a supernatural charisma that can enslave the will of kings and deities alike. Graz'zt seeks not merely to destroy the multiverse, but to possess it, transforming it into a palace of dark pleasures and exquisite tortures where he is the center of all worship.

variantes.resistente: Magic, Immune to Fire and Poison; Resistance to non-holy weapons
variantes.supervivencia: She is a perfect tactical warrior. Don't try to fly into it; Its air speed is unsurpassed. Use containment magic to try to land her and fight in tight areas.
variantes.habilidad: He carries a firearm that deals massive additional damage. He can teleport between attacks and his wings radiate a light that blinds sinners.
variantes.lore: Zariel, the Archduchess of Avernus, is a figure of heroic tragedy corrupted by eternal war. Once a solar angel from the celestial heavens, descended to Hell of her own free will to combat the abyssal evil that the gods ignored. Consumed by the fury of battle and disappointed by divine inaction, she ended up accepting command of Asmodeus's legions. He now rules the first layer of Hell with mystical discipline and unmatched ferocity, believing that only the absolute order of the Hells can save the multiverse from being devoured by the chaos of the Abyss.

variantes.resistente: Immune to non-magical weapons; Immune to Fire, Poison
variantes.supervivencia: Dispater is paranoid. He will use illusions and iron walls to protect himself. He will never fight alone; He will always have an army of automatons surrounding him.
variantes.habilidad: He can transform his enemies into iron statues with a touch. He is a master of defense, capable of deflecting any attack using his legendary shield.
variantes.lore: Dispater, the Lord of Iron, rules the fortress city of Dis with legendary paranoia and a mind that works like a perfect gear. He is the supreme bureaucrat and the keeper of Hell's state secrets. He rarely leaves his Iron Tower, convinced that every shadow hides a murderer and every contract has a loophole that his enemies could exploit against him. His genius for defense is absolute; Dis is said to be the most impregnable city of all existence, a labyrinth of iron and perpetual surveillance where thought itself is regulated by law.

variantes.resistente: Magic (Immune to low level), Immune to Fire and Cold
variantes.supervivencia: Don't use fire on him: it heals him. His infernal fire ignores all the group's resistances. You need very high level divine magic to even penetrate their arcane defenses.
variantes.habilidad: Its fire transcends the physical, burning the soul itself. He can cast ninth level spells and manipulate the structure of enemy magic to nullify it.
variantes.lore: Mephistopheles is the archmage of Hell, a scholar whose brilliance is eclipsed only by his arrogance and volcanic temper. He rules the frozen layer of Cania, where he spends eternity experimenting with the laws of magic and hellfire. Unlike other archdukes who seek souls through legal contracts, Mephistopheles seeks complete mastery over the very fabric of reality. He is Asmodeus's most direct rival in terms of intellectual power, and his ice laboratories are rumored to contain spells capable of remaking the blueprints in his image.

pit_fiend.supervivencia: Avoid tight formations due to his fireballs. Its bite stops all regeneration and magical healing.
pit_fiend.habilidad: Radiates magical fear that scares away heroes. Casts fireballs and magic-stopping spells indiscriminately.
pit_fiend.lore: Pit Fiends are the supreme generals of the Nine Hells, the perfect embodiment of tyrannical law and disciplined violence. As lords of legions, they possess not only brute physical strength capable of crushing castles, but a tactical mind that has planned wars for millennia. In the infernal hierarchy, only the Archdevils are above them. A Pit Fiend feels no doubt or fatigue; His mere presence on a battlefield imposes an absolute order based on terror, dictating the fate of thousands of souls with a single gesture of his iron claws.

marilith.resistente: Cold, Fire, Lightning; Magic (Advantage on saves)
marilith.supervivencia: Never confront her body to body. Attacks 7 times per turn and blocks physical attacks. You'll need a lot of control magic or pure ranged damage.
marilith.habilidad_titulo: Whirlwind of Swords and Inhuman Reactions
marilith.habilidad: Launch an offensive barrage of six long swords simultaneously. It has a Reaction for each turn of the round, allowing it to Parry constantly.
marilith.lore: The Marilith are the queens of abyssal war, demonic generals who possess a mind capable of processing hundreds of tactical variables simultaneously. With their six arms and their snake-like body, they perform a dance of death that blocks and attacks with every breath. They are not only masterful warriors, but also sadistic strategists who enjoy breaking the morale of enemy armies before annihilating them. In the Abyss, it is said that a Marilith never forgets a face or a defeat, and will pursue her enemies across the planes with icy, unwavering determination.

ultroloth.resistente: Cold, Fire, Lightning; Immune to Acid, Poison
ultroloth.supervivencia: Never look him in the eyes. His hypnotic gaze can take you out of combat instantly. You'll need mental protection and focused damage focus to overcome his magic resistance.
ultroloth.habilidad: Their enormous eyes can paralyze or enchant anyone who looks at them. He is a master of control magic, capable of dominating his enemies so that they fight among themselves.
ultroloth.lore: The Ultroloths are the shadowy aristocrats of the Yugoloth race, beings whose cruelty is surpassed only by their calculating intellect and infinite greed. With their alien appearance and their immense eyes that seem to contain flat voids, these beings manipulate the Blood War as if it were a chess game where the prize is gold and arcane power. They serve no cause other than their own benefit, and their complete lack of empathy makes them the most dangerous negotiators in the multiverse. It is said that an Ultroloth can buy the soul of a hero or the fate of a kingdom with a single whisper filled with poisoned promises.

malenia.resistente: Necrotic, Poison; Blunt, Piercing and Cutting (Non-magical)
malenia.supervivencia: Don't use shields, as their regeneration activates even if you manage to hit them. Dodge the 'Dance of the Waterfowl' by moving away from its 3 successive impact zones. In its second phase, flee from the explosion of the 'Scarlet Aeonia', or you will suffer a rot that cancels any healing.
malenia.habilidad: Heals 20 HP if he deals slashing damage on his turn. If she drops to 0 HP, she activates her mythical form 'Goddess of Rot': she does not die, recovers 200 HP, gains 45m flying speed, and unleashes her Scarlet Aeonia immediately.
malenia.lore: Malenia is one of the most formidable demigods, cursed from birth with the deadly Scarlet Rot. He has never known defeat; those who face its swift dance of blades rarely live to tell how its sword not only cuts flesh, but draws out its own vitality to heal its wielder.

frey.resistente: Air, Enchantment; Blunt, Piercing and Cutting (Non-magical)
frey.supervivencia: Keep your distance and avoid direct eye contact to avoid falling under their control. His mental domain can be broken if Frey takes significant damage or if his presence is silenced. Although she looks human, her claws can appear in an instant; Never let your guard down in melee.
frey.habilidad: Frey can transform his hands and feet into deadly claws for quick, devastating attacks. Additionally, he possesses the 'Eye of Control', a red gem on his forehead that allows him to subjugate the will of his enemies (DC 18 Wisdom), turning them into his temporary servants.
frey.lore: Frey is the ruler of all winged creatures and a former member of the Ten Great Demon Lords. Despite her immense power, she is known for being a humble and extremely cunning leader. She was born as a unique mutant among harpies, giving her superior potential. After a rift with his mother, Frey took the throne by force to lead his people into an era of greater influence. She is a loyal and protective ally, often acting as a motherly figure to those she considers close, such as the young Milim Nava.

sukuna.resistente: Cutting, Blunt and Piercing; Psychic, Necrotic
sukuna.supervivencia: Do not enter his 60 meter range if his Domain is available. Its cuts are invisible; the only way to survive is to have superior regeneration or absolute defense. If you see it form a fire arrow, run away immediately.
sukuna.habilidad: Sukuna can cut through reality itself. Its attacks ignore physical resistances. It can expand its domain to massacre everything within a 60m radius without leaving a trace of life.
sukuna.lore: Known as the King of Curses, Ryomen Sukuna is a demonic deity that existed a thousand years ago. In the golden age of sorcery, all the sorcerers joined forces to defeat him, but they failed. Upon his death, his twenty fingers were sealed as special grade cursed objects, as their power was too great to be destroyed. Sukuna is the embodiment of selfishness and brute force; It follows no philosophy other than the pleasure of massacring the strong and devouring the weak. His presence is so overwhelming that even other special grade cursed spirits tremble at the mention of him.

ainz.supervivencia: Don't let him complete his enchantments. His higher level magic can alter reality. If you use 'Time Stop', the combat is over before you know it. Its weakness is holy damage and extreme physical combat.
ainz.habilidad: Ainz is a master of necromantic magic. He can cast spells that kill instantly or summon legions of undead. Its mere presence causes terror in any living being.
ainz.lore: Formerly known as Momonga, he is the leader of the Great Tomb of Nazarick and the last member of the Ainz Ooal Gown guild. After being trapped in a fantasy world, he took on the role of an absolute monarch to find his former companions. Ainz is a masterful strategist who never enters combat without prior preparation, using hundreds of magical items and protective spells to ensure complete victory.

albedo.supervivencia: Albedo is nearly invulnerable to direct damage thanks to her three-layer armor. Ignore his physical attacks if you can, but be careful with his 'Ginnungagap' axe, which can destroy magic items and structures.
albedo.habilidad: Albedo can transfer damage taken by herself or her allies to her armor, drastically reducing it. She is the ultimate protector and will not allow anyone to touch her master.
albedo.lore: Albedo is the Overseer of the Guardians of the Great Tomb of Nazarick and is in charge of the overall management of the base. She is a succubus of incomparable beauty, dressed in a pure white dress and jet black wings. Although she is kind and diplomatic in management, in combat she becomes a fierce warrior with an unwavering defense, fueled by her obsessive love and absolute loyalty to Ainz Ooal Gown.

femto.nombre: Femto, The Fifth Angel of the Hand of God
femto.habitat: The Astral Plane, During an Eclipse
femto.supervivencia: Don't try to attack it directly with conventional weapons; Femto can distort space so that attacks never reach him. The only hope is a weapon that can cut through astral layers or a sacrifice of equal magnitude. If the air begins to compress, it flees from the center of its will.
femto.habilidad: Femto exists outside of common physical laws. He can repel any projectile or melee attack simply by distorting the space around him. His presence imposes a despair so deep that weak hearts can stop instantly.
femto.lore: Formerly known as Griffith, the leader of the Falcon Gang, Femto is the reincarnation of absolute desire following the mass sacrifice during the Eclipse. As the fifth member of the Hand of God, he is the one who governs destiny and causality. Femto has no remorse or humanity; It is an entity of pure astral will that seeks to establish its own kingdom over the remains of a world plunged into darkness.

zodd.supervivencia: Zodd seeks worthy warriors; If you are no match for him, he will ignore you or squash you like a bug. Its regeneration is extremely fast. If you lose an arm, you can attach it back in seconds. Be careful when his horns grow and his body transforms; His power increases drastically.
zodd.habilidad: Zodd recovers 20 life points at the start of each of his turns as long as he has at least 1 HP. Additionally, he can transform into a giant winged beast, increasing his size and destructive force.
zodd.lore: A legend among mercenaries, Zodd is said to have roamed battlefields for centuries searching for the ultimate adversary. He is not interested in political power or wealth, only the ecstasy of combat to the death. Although he serves the Hand of God, his only loyalty is to the force. His human form is that of a gigantic barbarian, but his true nature is that of an apostle with features of a bull and a lion, a beast that has slaughtered thousands.

bandidos.supervivencia: Don't let them surround you. Bandits often attack in groups and use simple tactics to distract their prey. If you see just one, there are probably five more in the shadows.
bandidos.habilidad: The bandit has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of his allies is within 5 feet (1.5 m) of the creature and the ally is not incapacitated.
bandidos.lore: Groups of outlaws lurk on the roads, waiting for unsuspecting merchants and travelers. Not everyone is a criminal by will; Many are deserters, ruined peasants or victims of war who have found the only way to survive in steel.

arpias.habitat: Cliffs, Coastal Ruins, Peaks of the Wind
arpias.supervivencia: Don't listen to their song; use earplugs or magic to deafen your party. If you can get them out of the air, their claws are much less dangerous on solid ground.
arpias.habilidad: The harpy sings a magical melody. Any humanoid or giant within 300 feet (90 m) who can hear the song must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw, or be charmed until the song ends.
arpias.lore: Sinister creatures with the face of an emaciated woman and the body of an immense scavenger bird. Harpies take sadistic pleasure in suffering and use their vocal gifts to lure unsuspecting travelers to the cliffs, where death awaits them among the rocks and their lethal claws.
